schemes.name: Crop Loss Input Subsidy (Disaster Relief)
schemes.summary: Relief (input subsidy) for farmers whose crops are damaged by notified natural calamities, paid under State/National Disaster Response Fund norms.
schemes.benefit: Input subsidy per hectare of affected area as per the SDRF/NDRF norms in force (see official notification).

rules.text: Applicant must be a farmer cultivating the affected land (owner or recorded cultivator).
Crop loss must be caused by a notified natural calamity such as heavy rain, flood, drought or hailstorm.
Assessed crop loss should be 33% or more for assistance under SDRF/NDRF norms.
Assistance is limited to a maximum area per farmer as specified in the norms (commonly up to 2 hectares).

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) – Crop Insurance Claim
schemes.summary: Crop insurance for notified crops; insured farmers can claim for localized calamities and post-harvest losses.
schemes.benefit: Insurance claim for yield loss / localized damage as assessed by the insurance company.

rules.text: Farmer must be enrolled/insured under PMFBY for the notified crop and area in the current season.
Localized calamity or post-harvest loss should be intimated within 72 hours of occurrence.
Post-harvest losses are covered for crops kept in cut-and-spread condition in the field for up to 14 days, for specified perils such as unseasonal rain.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.summary: Income support to eligible landholding farmer families, paid directly to bank accounts.
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer.

rules.text: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land recorded in their name are eligible, subject to exclusions.
Excluded categories include income-tax payers, institutional landholders, holders of constitutional posts and certain pensioners and professionals.
eKYC and Aadhaar-seeded bank account are required to receive instalments.

schemes.name: Crop Loan (KCC) Relief in Natural Calamities

names.hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा में फसल ऋण (KCC) राहत

schemes.summary: Banks may restructure/reschedule crop loans and provide fresh crop loans to farmers in areas declared affected by natural calamities.
schemes.benefit: Restructuring/rescheduling of existing crop loan and eligibility for fresh finance, as per RBI relief-measure directions.

rules.text: Applies to borrowers with crop loans in districts/areas declared affected by a natural calamity by the State Government.
Relief measures such as restructuring are generally linked to crop loss of 33% or more as assessed by the authorities.
